name: Workplace investigation record for counsel
summary: When counsel directs a workplace investigation, the HR investigator turns the interview notes and documents into one restricted record for that lawyer: the allegations, who said what, a dated chronology, where accounts differ, an evidence index and the follow-up still open, each pinned to its source.

sources.title: Its own published map of legal work: the workplace investigation record it describes for employment counsel and the HR investigator working under counsel.
